rollbackPolicy: Remove or ignore Phase 44K readiness metadata if any required evidence report is later invalidated.

blockerPolicy: Any public artifact, provider, broad-media, frontend secret, raw-chat execution, VLM, Demucs, or Track A unlock blocks Phase 44K.
